extName.description: Extension name (Chrome Web Store / browser UI)

extDescription.message: Auto-reload any tab on its own timer, from every 0.5 seconds to hours. Pause, resume, and stop automatically when the page changes.
extDescription.description: Extension description. Chrome Web Store limit: 132 characters.

commandToggleDescription.message: Start auto-reloading the current tab, or pause/resume it
commandToggleDescription.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut, shown on the browser's shortcuts page

popupTagline.message: Select a tab to auto-reload it.

openSettings.description: Button in the popup that opens the settings page

everySeconds.description: Static label for very short intervals. SECONDS is a number such as 1 or 0.5.

everySecondsRange.description: Static label for a randomized interval. MIN and MAX are numbers of seconds.

reloadCount.description: How many times the tab has been reloaded so far

reloadCountOfLimit.description: Reloads so far out of the limit set by the 'After N reloads' stop condition

stopTextPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the text box for the word to watch for on the page

optionProtectTyping.message: Don't reload while I'm typing on the page

optionRandomize.description: Followed by a number box and the word for 'sec'

alertTabAlreadyAdded.message: This tab is already selected for auto-reload

stoppedReason.description: Shown on a paused tab that stopped by itself. REASON is one of the 'stopped...' messages.

stoppedTextAppeared.description: TEXT is the word or phrase the user asked to watch for

notificationTitle.description: Desktop notification title. TAB is the title of the tab that stopped.

notificationMessage.description: Desktop notification body. REASON is one of the 'stopped...' messages.

menuAutoReloadEvery.description: Right-click menu item. DURATION is one of the 'duration...' messages.

defaultIntervalHelp.message: This interval will be used as the default when adding new tabs to auto-reload.

themeHelp.message: Applies to the popup and this settings page. "System default" follows your OS setting.

notifyOnStopLabel.message: Notify me when a tab stops

notifyOnStopHelp.message: Shows a desktop notification when a "Stop when" condition is reached. Click it to jump to the tab. Your browser will ask for permission the first time.

shortcutDescription.message: starts auto-reloading the current tab, or pauses/resumes it if it's already on the list.
shortcutDescription.description: Sentence that follows the key combination, e.g. 'Alt+Shift+U starts auto-reloading ...'

shortcutChangeFirefox.description: Menu path in Firefox's add-ons page, following 'about:addons →'

aboutDescription.message: Auto-reload selected browser tabs at customizable intervals

aboutFeatures.message: Per-tab intervals, pause/resume, stop conditions, notifications, random intervals, keyboard shortcut, right-click menu

madeWith.message: Made with ❤️ for better browser productivity
